From width 64, both kinds are connected. Within a width, the barrier falls as the matched units' activations correlate more. Permutations alone leave a barrier between two copies of one function that differ by per-unit rescaling, and quotienting rescaling removes it. A trained curve joins aligned endpoints that the straight line does not, both across the board and in the one flat, poorly connected cell of a load-by-temperature grid, where the accuracy deficit stays. So in this toy, connectedness after alignment is a property of width, of the symmetry group and of the path family, more than of the mechanism.
